On the morning of month 25 the apprenticeship ends: the Labyrinth closes its doors and the Lord's Pursuers come. There is no escape, and defeat means prison. Before then you must reach the Scepter and see an ending (clearing Sector 6 means nothing unless you take the Scepter or leave it behind). The apprentice-year display in the header turns red when 6 months remain.
1~3주는 마을에서 한 주에 한 가지(훈련·탐문·외부 탐험·여관)를 하고: In weeks 1–3 you do one thing per week in town (Training, Ask around, Expedition, Inn), and in week 4 you enter the Labyrinth. Fail to pay tax at month's end and you are exiled from the island. HP and injuries don't recover on their own — you must pay to rest at the Inn. Market prices and Inn fees rise every month. You can't train in the first month — the trainer only takes you once you come back alive from the Labyrinth. Shopping takes no time.
